label: gym_mushi_020_receptionist_01
text: Welcome to the Cortondo Gym! Would you like\nme to explain the rules of the Gym Test again?

label: gym_mushi_020_receptionist_02
text: The Gym Test here is the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Olive Roll[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_mushi_020_receptionist_03
text:
To pass the test, you’ll need to roll an olive-
shaped ball all the way to the goal.\c
Your efforts should help ensure we get a great
olive harvest next year, too!

label: gym_mushi_020_receptionist_04
text:
When you’re ready to start, head to the olive-
rolling field just to the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]north of town[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
The staffer over there will explain the rules to
you in further detail.

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_01
text: Welcome to the olive-rolling field!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_02
text: This Gym Test is all about stamina—you’ll need\nto push with all you’ve got to get a large olive\r\nball rolling and make it all the way to the end.

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_03
text: Get the ball over various obstacles, then push it\ninto the goal to clear the course.

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_04
text: Now that you’re all filled in, are you ready to\nstart the Gym Test?

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_05
text: Great! Put in a wish for a good olive harvest,\nand roll, roll, roll away!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_06
text: No problem. Just come let me know when you’re\nall set to go.

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_07
text: Welcome back! Are you ready for some\nolive rolling?

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_08
text: Here, I’ll open up a shortcut for you...if you\nmanage to defeat me!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_09
text: Let’s see if you can get past my wall of Smoliv!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_10
text: OK, Team Smoliv! Time to clear the way!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_11
text: You should ride a Pokémon and get it to push the\nolive for you. It’ll be much easier to roll that way!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_12
text: With that performance, I’m sure we can look\nforward to a great olive harvest next year!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_13
text: I’m happy to declare your Gym Test officially\ncleared. Congratulations!

label: gym_mushi_020_trainer_14
text: Please report your result to the lobby staffer at\nthe Gym. Good luck in your battle against Katy!

text: Do you want to give up on the Olive Roll\nfor now?
